artifact_review: The Router identified 'blur' (severity 4) and 'texture anomaly' (severity 3). The low confidence on the Right Ankle (keypoint 16) supports the Router's suspicion of structural ambiguity in the hind/front limb interface. The severity of the texture/edge issues is likely underestimated by the Router (3/5) and the PQ Auditor (0.4/5); it represents a significant failure in realistic rendering, even if caused by compression/generation mix. I will maintain a moderate-high artifact penalty.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class (Red Wolf) with high confidence (Top-1). The alignment is good at the genus level but lacks the fine-grained fidelity required for a perfect score.
